description: This file defines an Angular service class 'AlarmService' that provides methods for interacting with alarm-related API endpoints, including retrieving, saving, acknowledging, clearing, assigning, unassigning, deleting alarms, and fetching alarm types and severity levels.

classes.name: AlarmService
classes.description: An Angular injectable service class that provides methods to interact with alarm-related API endpoints for CRUD operations, querying, and alarm severity retrieval.

methods.name: getAlarm
methods.description: Retrieves an alarm by its ID.

methods.name: getAlarmInfo
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about an alarm by its ID.

methods.name: ackAlarm
methods.description: Acknowledges an alarm by its ID.

methods.name: clearAlarm
methods.description: Clears an alarm by its ID.

methods.name: assignAlarm
methods.description: Assigns an alarm to an entity.

methods.name: deleteAlarm
methods.description: Deletes an alarm by its ID.

methods.name: getAlarms
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of alarms based on a query.

methods.name: getAlarmsV2
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of alarms using the version 2 API.

methods.name: getAllAlarms
methods.description: Retrieves all alarms matching a query.

methods.name: getAllAlarmsV2
methods.description: Retrieves all alarms using the version 2 API.

methods.name: getHighestAlarmSeverity
methods.description: Fetches the highest severity level of alarms for a given entity, filtered by search status or alarm status.

methods.name: getAlarmTypes
methods.description: Retrieves available alarm types with pagination.
